gloss: trot; light jog; quick trotting steps

definitions.gloss: trot; light jog; quick short steps
definitions.explanation: Running with short, quick steps — faster than walking but not a full sprint. A light, hurried way of moving, often to catch up with someone or get somewhere quickly without actually running hard.

examples.english: It started raining, so I jogged to the convenience store.

notes:
Describes a pace between walking and running — short, quick steps taken when you need to hurry but aren't sprinting. Very common in everyday narration and descriptions of movement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小走|こばし}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at a trot, jogging (used adverbially with で)
- {小走|こばし}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧: to hurry along at a trot
- {小走|こばし}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to break into a trot

USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle で to describe the manner of movement: {小走|こばし}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧, {小走|こばし}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{早足|はやあし}→早足：21118_hayaashi⟧: brisk walk, quick pace — fast walking rather than jogging
- ⟦{駆|か}け{足|あし}→駆け足：22316_kakeashi⟧: running, double-time — faster pace, a real run
- ⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧: jogging — exercise-oriented, not the hurried everyday trot that {小走|こばし}り describes
